svg.title: PureHDF Async-First Read Path — Sync vs Async Code Paths
svg.desc: Layered dependency graph of the PureHDF read path on branch feat/async-read-path, showing where each driver and stream sits in the sync/already-completed/suspending cost tiers, the TryReadDatasetSync vs ReadDatasetAsync branch, the ReadAheadWindow coalescing layer, the IsBuffered gate on IH5ReadStream, and how each layout feeds the per-element decode.
svg.text: PureHDF Async-First Read Path — Sync vs Async Code Paths
Branch feat/async-read-path · cost tier per layer · IsBuffered gate: contiguous batching matches chunked/compact for compound/reference reads

g.text: SYNC — Span path, no ValueTask, zero alloc
ALREADY-COMPLETED ValueTask — no state machine, zero alloc
return default; · inlines, no continuation boxed
GENUINELY SUSPENDS — state machine, may box continuation
async/await · only when source can actually suspend
LAYER 1 · PUBLIC API (sync surface blocks on async core — gray = blocking wrapper, not the zero-alloc Span fast path; async is the only safe entry on a host that cannot block, e.g. WASM)
walks path, decodes links — suspends on remote
walks selection, decodes — suspends on remote
VL/ref resolves global heap — suspends on remote
LAYER 2 · NATIVE READ PATH (decode, selection, batching)
~24-32 B/element — no async trick fixes this
1. TryReadDatasetSync(Span) — taken when source opts in
2. fallback to ReadDatasetAsync(Memory) + Cast only on suspend
Skips CastMemoryManager alloc on local/mmap sources
one ReadDatasetAsync for N cell headers
IsBuffered gate → bulk-read only when live driver
N×M dispatches → 1 bulk read + N×M in-memory copies
collapses N×M driver dispatches to one bulk read
secondary paths, single bulk read each
marginal benefit from TryReadDatasetSync — removes 1 of 3 async layers
4 KiB sliding window · one per driver · NO synchronization
(driver has one logical reader → no contention)
FileStream buffer entirely. Without it: 484 reads /
1,828 B for one attribute lookup → ~363 k syscalls.
Structural reads only. Bulk payload bypasses (large,
read-once → would evict the structure it holds).
→ OffsetStream wrapping the live file driver
N×M driver dispatches → 1 read + N×M in-memory copies
non-VL compound/reference/array only · blittable struct takes zero-copy fast path
cache miss → fetch + decompress chunk → buffer
per-element reads are memory copies, not syscalls
data lives in the object header itself
default path · Memory because Span can't cross await
called by hundreds of internal call sites
opt-in sync path · zero-alloc Span via MemoryMarshal.AsBytes
avoids CastMemoryManager alloc (~32 B/scalar) on hot decode
pure arithmetic — never IO · deliberately synchronous
in-memory or range-backed sources seek by offset math
each driver implements — already-completed or suspending
default: assume remote → never accidentally blocked on
same source, own cursor → concurrent reads of one resolved dataset
LAYER 6 · DRIVERS (per-source — TryReadDatasetSync opt-in is decided here)
zero-alloc Span path on hot decode
bulk payload straight into caller's buffer — would evict the structure
ReadScalar uses 8-byte field, IsCompletedSuccessfully fast path (no async)
zero-alloc Span path on hot decode
already-completed, no state machine, no allocation
cost-identical to a direct sync read
accessor is already random-access in-memory — window would only add a copy
only driver that can genuinely suspend
a stream may genuinely suspend — blocking on it is what async avoids
cursor in driver · stream never seeked
RefillThenServe = ONLY async method on the read path · ReadScalarSlow on suspend
LAYER 7 · UNDERLYING SOURCE (where the bytes actually come from)
bypasses FileStream buffer entirely — that's the
RandomAccess.ReadAsync on Unix + non-async FileStream would queue
every read to thread pool → +633 B/Read → 40-60% slowdown
second driver over same accessor = own _position, correct
concurrency safe without a per-driver cursor of its own
AmazonS3Stream implements IDatasetStream with 1 MiB slots
(its own block cache — composes with ReadAheadWindow, doesn't duplicate)

Layout batching status — Chunked: batched (SystemMemoryStream over chunk buffer, IsBuffered=true) · Compact: batched (in-place, IsBuffered=true) · Contiguous: batched via IsBuffered gate (OffsetStream IsBuffered=false → bulk-read triggers, collapses compound/reference dispatch)
Per-operation driver model: resolve first (single-threaded, file-level cursor) → read in parallel (per-op driver, own cursor, shared source). Parallelism does not require one reader per thread.
